title: Determine the Area of Triangles
objective: I can find the area of a triangle using the formula A = ½ × base × height.
model: triangle as half of a parallelogram with the same base and perpendicular height, resized with sliders

widgets.component: prerequisite warm-up: rectangle area, parallelogram area, how the parallelogram height is measured, missing height
widgets.root: All four are 5-1 mathematics and the exact skills 5-2 builds on (9 × 4 = 36, perpendicular height, 48 ÷ 8 = 6); distractors include the wrong unit (cubic) and added dimensions.

widgets.component: supported triangle area: A = ½ × b × h, height from the area, 'why divide by 2' (half of a rectangle), two-row table, err that stops at b × h
widgets.root: Recomputed 30, 6, 42, 24, 25 sq ft; 2.3 states the lesson's idea (a triangle is half of a rectangle with the same base and height); the err item stops at 36 and the fix halves it once. Triangle formula is taught in this lesson.

widgets.component: four-row table with two divide-back rows, triangle versus parallelogram/rectangle match, 'two halves' error
widgets.root: Keys 48, 6, 7, 30; match 24, 40, 30, 20, 21, 18. Pairs deliberately contrast the ½ rule with the b × h rule, which is the 5-1 / 5-2 boundary and is allowed because 5-1 precedes. Err 3.4 halves both b and h.

widgets.component: number-line placement of the height of a triangle with base 10 and area 35
widgets.root: The question stem prints the whole solution: '(Hint: 35 = ½ × 10 × h → 35 = 5h → h = 7)'. The student places the point at 7, which the stem has just written, so no reasoning is needed.
widgets.replacement: Remove the worked hint from the stem and keep only 'A triangle has a base of 10 ft and an area of 35 sq ft. Place a point at its height.' Move 'double the area first' to the hint ladder (h[0]), widen the line to min 0, max 15, step 1, and keep the key 7. Add a wrong-answer rule for 3.5 ('you divided 35 by 10 and forgot the ½') and 17.5 ('you divided by ½ twice').

widgets.where: Practice §4 items 1-6 and Challenge §1 items 1-6 (gen:areaTriangle L1-L4)
widgets.component: generated triangle word problems with a drawn triangle (acute and right triangles, slanted side, 'rectangle cut by a diagonal')
widgets.root: viz shape 'tri' draws the figure with its aspect ratio clamped to 0.8-3 (assets/studio-viz-geo.js SHAPES.tri: ratio(b, h, 1.5, 0.8, 3)). Over 300 seeds per level, 1-5% of the draws are more than 1.5 times off (L1 4, L2 16, L3 15, L4 10 of 300) and the worst, the 7-24-25 right triangle, is drawn 2.7 times too wide (legs 7 and 24 shown as roughly 0.8 : 1). The labels (base 7, height 24) then contradict the picture. Everything else checks out: the height is a perpendicular dashed line (or a leg for right triangles), the apex position is derived from the given slanted side, right-angle marks are present, and keys come from the independent check().
widgets.replacement: Widen the clamp in SHAPES.tri to ratio(b, h, 1.5, 0.2, 5) and let the existing scale sc = min(1.25, 330/g.w, 176/g.h) shrink the drawing; for right triangles pass the legs unclamped. Add a ghost option {"ghost":"rect"} that dashes the enclosing b × h rectangle, and set it on the L1 'A rectangle has a base of ... A triangle has the same base and the same height' variants (about a third of the L1 draws), so the picture shows the half. Add a studio-gen test that the drawn polygon's width/height equals dims.b/dims.h within 2% for every areaTriangle draw.

widgets.where: Practice §4.7 act:sizer L2, Challenge §3.1-3.2 act:sizer L3, L4 (shape tri, goal area)
widgets.component: sizer: sliders for base and height of a triangle on a unit grid, parallelogram ghost, readout ½ × b × h
widgets.root: A real manipulable model of the lesson's idea: the ghost parallelogram shows the triangle as half, the readout shows the student's own ½ × b × h, graded on the area, and the feedback names 'forgot-half'. L3/L4 steps 0.5 and 0.25.

widgets.component: Connect check: 'What is the area of the triangular wall?', 'How many cans of paint does she need?', 'Why round up instead of down?' (now carried with the Connect scenario text and the Connect diagram)
widgets.root: The generator now prepends the Connect scenario to each item (ctx), so the givens are on screen, but the figure it attaches is the Connect coordinate plane with only the corner dots plotted: no polygon is drawn, there is no dashed perpendicular height and no right-angle mark (checked by rendering the spec). The student must infer the shape and the height from four unconnected points, which is the representation this lesson exists to teach.
widgets.replacement: Extend diagramToViz (scripts/lib/practice-studio-config.mjs) so a coordinate-plane diagram whose points form a polygon emits "polygon" (point indexes in order) and, for the area lessons, a foot-of-the-height point plus "segments" for the dashed perpendicular. Exact spec for this lesson: {"t":"coord","xmin":0,"xmax":20,"ymin":0,"ymax":20,"grid":true,"points":[{"x":0,"y":0,"l":"A (0,0)"},{"x":20,"y":0,"l":"B (20,0)"},{"x":10,"y":14,"l":"C (10,14)"},{"x":10,"y":0,"l":"D (10,0)"}],"polygon":[0,1,2],"segments":[[2,3]]}. Keep the scenario text and the three items.
